prompt: Hand-drawn INK ILLUSTRATION on a painted wood panel, visible wood grain showing faintly through the paint. Texture made entirely by HAND-DRAWN HATCHING — fine contour lines following forms, chevron and zigzag fills, crosshatch — never by soft gradients or glow. Bold flat black negative space. Two tiny black silhouette creatures stand in the lane, featureless flat black shapes; one carries a small coral dot of light. The night sky is flat solid black. Vast scale, tiny village.
